snowGarages.name: Auditorium Garage
snowGarages.notes: Discounted parking is only for Back Bay, Beacon Hill, Chinatown, Downtown, Fenway/Kenmore, and South End residents. You will be charged each time you exit and re-enter the garage with your vehicle.

snowGarages.name: The Prudential Center Garage
snowGarages.notes: Discount only for Back Bay, Beacon Hill and South End. If parking ban ends before 6PM residents must move cars within two hours. If ban ends after 6PM residents have till 9AM the following morning to remove cars.  Need to stop by level P2 to get discount

snowGarages.name: Motor Mart Garage
snowGarages.notes: Discounted parking for all Boston residents with a City Of Boston Resident Parking Permit or proof of Boston residency.  Enter up to 2 hours before emergency goes into effect and exit within 2 hours of the ban being lifted.
